notes.title: Update 1.2: Monastery Life and Simplified Chinese!
notes.notes:
Hello young gods!

Two exciting events today; the game is available in [b]simplified Chinese[/b] and Update 1.2: Monastery Life is ready for you to play!

[h2]Simplified Chinese[/h2]
We recently got the opportunity to translate Godhood into Simplified Chinese. We gladly took this chance, which we're grateful for. We hope our new Chinese gods will enjoy playing Godhood! We're continuing to look for opportunities to translate the game to other languages. 

[h2]Monastery Life[/h2]
We already showed some of the new things that would arrive in this new update. I'll quickly highlight 2 other improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/ecdea30c6325d753a77488669854fb425d258c82.png[/img]
[h3]Two New Traditions[/h3] 
With [b]Martial Arts[/b] you need to take control over your initiative. Overpower abilities will lower Armor for 1 round, so you want others to capitalize on it. To go even further, you can bless their fists, which is stronger the slower your Disciple is!
The second tradition is the [b]Monastery of Miracles[/b]. This tradition makes your Sorceries bedazzle the opponent, lowering their accuracy. More importantly, you can inspire a humbling augury; your weakest Disciple will become unbreakable, and give you extra tributes for the next Sacrament. A great way to boost the growth of your younglings!

[h3]Class Revamp[/h3]
The classes you pick for your Disciples will now have extra effects. For example, the Beastmaster will now gain extra Crit Chance, and the weaver will more often than not hit the weakest target! You can check the changes in class selection, or the class window in the right!
With this change we hope to give the classes some extra character!

The full patch notes:

[b]ADDED[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the Excommunicate God Action, which allows you to boot Disciples after building the Sun Stone. It costs happiness and permanent faith though.
[*] NEW TRADITION: Monastery of Miracles. Enchant your enemies with miracles, and boost your young prospects!
[*] NEW TRADITION: Martial Arts. Control your initiative and Overpower abilities to perform devastating combos!
[*] NEW TENETS: Reclusion and Pain is Gain.
[*] Classes can now improve and penalize a variety of stats. For example, the Lust Priest will gain extra physical accuracy and target smarter, but will have -1 Fervor.
[*] Full Simplified Chinese translations
[/list]

[b]FIXED[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing Dedication (Aristocrat, Kickstarter)
[*] Fixed missing celebratory buildings for some Traditions
[*] Fixed Dream-exploit where a single dream assignment could be executed any number of times by abusing the button.
[*] No longer need to pick a tenet or tradition when you have enough points, but no available options.
[*] Fixed some content in enemy Sacraments
[*] Fixed a bug in which some characters would get less experience
[*] Fixed the Cultist passive "God of Magic"
[*] Fixed issue where leveling a disciple quickly would skip a passive tier
[*] Fixed some text issues.
[*] Fixed floating freckles and chest-hair in disciple portraits
[/list]

[b]BALANCE[/b]
[list]
[*] Order of Monks gives Monastery of Miracles instead of Hermit Pilgrimage.
[*] Promote Virginity gives Monastery of Miracles instead of Holy Marriage.
[*] Secret Society gives Monastery of Miracles instead of Burial.
[*] School of Philosophy gives Reclusion instead of Order of Monks
[*] Hermit Pilgrimage gives Reclusion instead of Holy Cats
[*] Revelations gives Reclusion
[*] Doom gives reclusion instead of Ritual Cleaning
[*] Madness starts with Reclusion
[*] Order of Paladins gives Martial Arts instead of burial
[*] Blood Sport gives Martial Arts instead of Might Makes Right
[*] The Holy Banana is back my dudes!
[*] Smite now has a different effect, since the last one was broken.
[/list]

That's it for today! We hope you'll enjoy playing the game!
- Greetings from the Abbey

notes.title: Godhood Update 1.2 coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello young gods!

We're finishing up on the newest update for Godhood, which has some new content and a new feature! Here's a sneak-peek of what's to come!

[h2]Excommunicate[/h2]
Do you know that feeling when you pick a guy named Adarian to be your prophet, but he turns out to be of little faith? Well, now you can get rid of him whenever you want! Just use the "Excommunicate" action to make him look for another god. Excommunicating Disciples that just don't live up to your expectations is a bit of a "jerk god" move, so it will impact how the people see you a bit. Faith and happiness are permentantly lowered by a bit.

If only the people knew how lame Adarian was, they would understand. Alas, the trials of being a god are many.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/c76ee67e4329ee8f5958054b21a4e2de1ad88b45.png[/img]
[h2]New Tenets[/h2]
Talking about trials and pains; there will be two new tenets with their own little effects on your society!  They are themed in hardship and pain, and will lead to some new traditions. With "[i]Pain is Gain[/i]", you tell your followers that suffering is for the greater good.  With "[i]Reclusion[/i]" you'll order your disciples to not seek contact with each other. Only by suffering in solitude they can find enlightenment.

Now what traditions will they lead too..?


That's not all! Another community idea also made the cut, but we'll keep that one for the announcement!
Hope to see you soon,
- The Abbey

notes.title: Update 1.1: Freedom of Religion
notes.notes:
Hello young gods!

Today we bring you a new update packed with some requested features, fixes and some community ideas! Let's dive right into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/e60573f92475b784d303dd32c64452df5bbc1591.gif[/img]

[h2]Free Mode[/h2]
When you select the difficulty for your run of Godhood, you can now also enable [b]Free Mode.[/b] This will unlock all Tenets and Traditions without meeting their prerequisites! This will allow you to create truly incoherent religions easily, or finally try out that killer combo you had in mind. If you wish, you can even mix-up starting commandments like Pleasure and Madness to gain access to an extra starting relic and their class! Go crazy!

[h2]New Traditions[/h2]
With Freedom of Religion, we introduce [b]4 new Traditions[/b]! They are all [i]Community Ideas[/i]!
[list]
[*][b]Revelations[/b]: Age your Disciples quicker, and give them one final revelation before their death. This will give you more Development Sparks and control over your roster!
[*][b]Brain Washing[/b]: Warn coming generations about the dangers of knowledge. This tradition focuses on Overpower abilities, and trades future Knowledge for Faith.
[*][b]Reincarnation[/b]: Your first Prophet doesn't die, but simply reincarnates in a new body! A powerful tradition that focuses on one Disciple to do the heavy lifting.
[*][b]Alchemy[/b]: Use the wonders of your science to turn Offerings into Materials, and assign an Alchemist that can give random buffs to your allies. A flexible and physical tradition!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/e99ce3abd7e7f72f1e8b81afd93d76bde90ef52d.png[/img]

[h2]Many Quality Improvements[/h2]
To complete the patch notes, here is a list of other changes, both big and small, made to Godhood!

ADDED
[list]
[*] Added a feature for Kickstarter backers to select their preferred holy site.
[*] Added a way to inspect traditions while picking tenets. [i]Community Idea[/i]
[*] Added a small happening to celebrate the adoption of a new Tradition! [i]Community Idea[/i]
[*] Extra information in the Sacrament Log about crits, interception, breaking and victory type.
[/list]

BALANCE
[list]
[*] XP requirements down to 6/12/20/28/30 [i]Community Idea[/i]
[*] Made easy easier.
[*] Removed "Any" style from the game. You now always will have some degree of control over the abilities someone learns. [i]Community Idea[/i]
[*] Lowered HP of final boss encounter.
[*] You now get better totems faster for your Disciple.
[*] Divine Recipe now stacks "only" up to +100 faith.
[*] Holy Judge now gives a base of +1 tribute, and no longer has a faith penalty. However, it doesn't develop Devotion anymore.
[*] Made numerous balance changes to some sacraments.
[*] Medium difficulty no longer gives enemies a 10% penalty. This was a remnant of an old system.
[/list]

FIXED
[list]
[*] Fixed some spelling/naming errors
[*] Fixed cooldowns of certain Rituals resetting on game load or other actions. (e.g. XP Gain Ritual).
[*] The city turn timer is now placed above the Destined Trial preview when the latter contains multiple Sacraments to make more space for ritual and action buttons.
[*] Fixed rare crash when developing Rituals in the late-game.
[*] Fixed 'Perfectionist' achievement never triggering. Should also work for existing sessions.
[*] Fixed 'Explorer' achievement never triggering. Requires defeating all bosses with patch 1.1 or higher. Sorry :\
[*] Fixed a missing text for some higher level miracles.
[/list]


[h2]Artbook[/h2]
The Artbook with juicy development secrets and charming concept art is now also available! Those who got the Supporter edition should have it already. Interested in behind the scenes look into the world of Godhood? Give it a look![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/49b5e3af71af6b0ff95ed59c6634df88ea40fe4e.jpg[/img]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
For you who have been following us for a long time - thank you immensely for your support! With the increase in quality of Godhood, we've seen a good increase in the number of players! We're happy to say Abbey Games has survived with your help, and we're preparing ourselves for the next challenge!

That doesn't mean we're done with Godhood at all! There are still some cool community ideas we would love to implement. So expect more from Godhood in the future!

Greetings from the Abbey

notes.title: Update #6: Tenets & Traditions is here!
notes.notes:
Young gods!

We're happy to present our sixth update: [b]Tenets & Traditions[/b]! This is a Milestone update with massive game-changing features.  We're still in Early Access, so if you find any bugs or major imbalances, please let us know!

[h2]Historic Discount[/h2]
Starting today, Godhood is on sale with a historic 40% off discount! We believe that this milestone update presents a massive jump in quality for the game. With this discount we'd like to invite everyone to try out Godhood. With 'Tenets & Traditions' released, there was never a better time to play Godhood!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/2c3d0f70e77c8daf249ee5ddde7c6a0208b0343d.png[/img]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Tenets[/b]: Removed the old Development trees. You can now more freely adopt tenets that boost your whole religion and changes the behavior of your followers.
[*][b]Traditions[/b]: Unlock Traditions through adopting Tenets. Traditions are game changers that give you new options and influence your society for generations!
[*][b]Happiness[/b]: Replaces the Crystal Skull mechanic. Keep your people happy, and good things will happen. Make them angry, and sin will spread!
[*][b]Consequences[/b]: Little stories will trigger in the Holy City based on your Tenets and Happiness.
[*][b]Crowds[/b]: Sacrament crowds now react to your Disciples' actions.
[*][b]Rituals[/b]: Disciples will perform upgradeable Rituals every day. Do a Ritual enough, and your Disciple becomes stronger. Miracles increase the effectiveness of Rituals.
[*][b]God Actions[/b]: Burn Offerings to do specific powers in your Holy City, like granting XP, boosting a Ritual, or something Tradition related, like arranging a Holy Marriage.
[*][b]Stat Ranking[/b]: Achieve stat thresholds with a Disciple to gain a powerful boost, giving you short term development goals.
[*][b]Blessings[/b]: Give out small blessings to improve your favorite disciple ever turn.
[*][b]Relic Choice[/b]: Instead of getting a random relic, you can now pick from a pool.
[*][b]Side Bosses[/b]: Optional Bosses that give a nice reward, but are hard to convert.
[*][b]Tribute Chests[/b]: Victory gives you Tribute Chests now, which you can influence and upgrade.
[*][b]New Temples[/b]: A new visual for Base Temples.
[*][b]Corruption[/b]: Disciple Power is now a strain on their faith.
[/list]


[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] 40+ Tenets
[*] 20+ Traditions
[*] 90+ Consequence Happenings
[*] 30+ God Powers.
[*] 10+  Challenges
[*] 10+ Relics
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/486b4ee560240d5b50c92be6d46678ddca723c88.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements & Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] A few tutorials have been added and improved.
[*] UI shows context for a lot of actions.
[*] Changed how Dreams work, flow wise. You can now assign all your dreams right before Sacrament.
[*] Changes some abilities of the lust priest to make some more sense.
[*] Passives that increase base damage (like the Weaver and Executioner) have been toned down a bit.
[*] All challenges have been adapted to the new balance
[*] Classes are now cheaper to unlock, but get more expensive the more you unlock.
[*] All old upgrades that targeted the whole religion have been removed in favor of standard unlocks or one of the new systems.
[*] Martyrdom now gives Tribute Chests, and goes up to 2. This is to avoid very wild gambles and snowball effects.
[*] Hp no longer scales of Devotion and Health. This was the main culprit of some pretty wack late game problems.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
Too many! We also changed so much that we probably introduced more than we fixed! Help us with the next update by reporting any bugs you find on one of our forums!


To show off all of the juicy new game features, we'll be [b]streaming the game![/b]
[list]
 [*] Today, June 24th, at 17:00 CEST (8:00 Pacific Time)
 [*] Tomorrow, June 25th, at 18:00 CEST (9:00 Pacific Time)
[/list]
We will stream on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/abbeygames]Twitch[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/AbbeyGames]Youtube [/url]and right here on Steam. Maybe we'll see you there?

My word, again a massive update! We'll be keeping busy with fixing anything you find, improving the UI, and adding more content to the game! We're moving full steam ahead to our 1.0 release. There, we will finally fulfill our promises: Greed, Achievements, and a big finale to the game! How will your religion influence the future?!

Please let us know what you think, if we improved the game, or how you think we can do even better! You're all also invited to join our [url=https://discord.gg/Wa4Pcn]Discord[/url] to come talk with us.

Hope you'll enjoy the update; we are very proud of it!
- Greetings from the Abbey

notes.title: Update #6 Sneak Peak: Improvements Showcase
notes.notes:
Hello young Gods,

We are a week into testing our new update, and we've been overwhelmed by all the positive responses! There is still plenty to fix, but you can expect the [b]Tenets & Traditions[/b] update to arrive soon! Until then, let us dive into some of the other changes we made. There are too many to list them, so we'll go over the ones we think deserve some attention!

[h2]Crowds[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/56d858540be6857930c5ab44cce68fb5909ccdf1.gif[/img]

Always thought it was weird when people were cheering when playing Madness? So did we! From next update on, the crowd will react to your style and commandment. Strike fear into their hearts, make them drop down in awe, or DESTROY your opponents with FACTS and LOGIC to make them all nod in agreement.


[h2]Stat Ranking[/h2]
[b]Stat Ranking[/b] is a new mechanic that looks small at first, but will give you a much smoother core game experience. The stat of a Disciple now has two parts: [b]Value[/b] and [b]Rank[/b]. The Value we all know; it's the number on which everything scales. e.g. More Health means more armor and more damage from your Guardian abilities! 
The [b]Rank[/b] of a stat is represented by a letter, going from 'F' all the way up to 'S'. When the value of a stat reaches a certain threshold, your Rank in that stat goes up.  A higher rank gives instant big bonuses depending on the stat. For example, raise your "devotion" from 19 to 20, and you'll go up to Rank D. This will give an instant +10 Morale Armor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/3a2dfc7477b4a007b197bb1e4fa833d67cf07239.gif[/img]

[i]When selecting Rituals to boost your stats, keep an eye for the arrow that indicates a Rank Up![/i]


This seemingly small change breaks up the stat part of the game into nice chunks. Previously it could be hard to see the difference between your Disciples before and after a training. With a Rank Up, you'll know for sure that your Disciple has become a lot stronger!


[h2]Relic Choice[/h2]
A neat new feature that hasn't made it to the beta yet, is [b]Relic Choice[/b]. Instead of getting a random relic, you can select the Relic as a symbol of your succesful mission! The relics will be a bit common at first. In the future, they'll be more dependent on the islands you convert. This might sound familiar for Renowned Explorer fans out there!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/bfdd43a2f40d29f68b311bffb74b04ccada1f776.gif[/img]



[h2]Content: Hermit Pilgrimage[/h2]
One of the 20+ Traditions you can adopt is the [b]Hermit Pilgrimage[/b]. To unlock it, you'll need a chaste and enlightening Tenet. Maybe something like meditation?
This tradition lets you send out a Disciple to find themself [strike]on a trip to Bali[/strike]. This action will cost you offerings, and the disciple will be unavailable for a while!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/f88b95d1c7ffa0575dba69ed5500ee548b64df2d.gif[/img]

[i]Off to find wisdom![/i]


When the Disciple return, they will be wiser and more experienced. The Pilgrimage will grant them +8 XP and 2 Ability points. This is a great and flexible way to bring boost your Disciples - if you have the offerings to spare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/e6e4a5c6a5e4f930ccb39bc3c69effbf2ec7e409.gif[/img]

[i]Elo returns with wisdom (and a beard)![/i]


[h2]More to come![/h2]
This is just a showcase of a few of our favorite changes! Expect [b]Tenets & Traditions[/b] to drop in your downloads soon! if you want to discuss more Godhood, leave your comments in the forums, or join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/KQJqz8]Discord[/url]! We hope you're excited for this new update!

- Greetings from the Abbey

notes.title: Update #6 Sneak-Peek: Temples & Rituals
notes.notes:
Hello young gods!

Here we are with some new info on our upcoming update! This time, let's look at [b]Miracles[/b] and [b]Rituals[/b]! First, the old places like the [i]Farm[/i] and [i]Meditation Circle[/i] have been replaced by real temples.

For example, the [i]Farm[/i] has been replaced by the [b]Temple of Harvest[/b].  Around the temple, other buildings will pop up. The harvest temple encourages more farms to be build. The harvest is blessed anyway!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/9d4d0e42a0712bf4aba3a342234db428363beb0a.gif[/img]


It's still a place to improve your Disciples to become stronger. However, it's effects are a little bit different...


[h2]Rituals[/h2]
One of the things we often see coming back in feedback, is that the Disciples don't do much on their own. Well, not anymore! Disciples will now perform rituals every day to improve themselves and their understanding of your will.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/61bc6270accca7076e601bc248f39ae7e6b94707.gif[/img]


Once these Rituals have been completed a certain amount of time, the Disciple will develop and become stronger! The miracles you give to your disciples will increase the effectiveness of these Rituals. Every Ritual will influence another field, and you can customize your Rituals to fit your strategy better. In a madness religion who is out to end humanity you'll call to Stalk the sick, scream in panic, or dabble in the occult.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/ce95491b257baf6c8a5268ffb2a8437ba2ce5283.png[/img]

This has major implications for the gameplay. All your disciples will develop, even those who you give less attention. Increase in power is also going to be a lot more tangeable, especially in combination with our new [b]stat rank system[/b]. It also makes for a smoother and deeper play experience.


[h2]Open Beta[/h2]
We can't believe (ha ha) how far Godhood has come! We're getting really close to our goal; a deep, indirect, game about creating a religion. But we're not there yet! We will need your help just a little bit more to get Godhood to its acension!
You can help by taking part of the open beta and provide us with feedback! We're looking for feedback on the new systems, and how you perceive them. Are they understandable? Do you miss or like something about the new Tenets? Are there game breaking bugs?

To play the open beta, you can switch to via the 'Betas' tab in Godhood's properties.
It's not exactly stable yet, and you will encounter bugs, but we think you'll find it has improved considerably from the last version in terms of gameplay and theme. If you don't like change, don't try it out!
As a bonus we've made steam branches for all previous milestone versions as well, in case anyone wants to revisit the Early Access history of Godhood.

notes.title: Update #6 Sneak-peek: Tenet Development!
notes.notes:
Salute, young gods,

In this Sneak-peak we want to show off one of our most exciting new features: [b]Tenet Development[/b]! We had our fair share of feedback on how there is not enough Religion-making in Godhood. We agree. To support this demanding fantasy, we made some big changes to how your religion develops in Godhood.

[h2]Tenets[/h2]
Instead of having a tree that narrows down your path, you will now be able to create your religion much more to your liking. Whenever your community has developed far enough, you will be able to pick a [b]Tenet[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/7c9812957047f342742f3017d7bbb19bc9b95235.gif[/img]

A tenet can be about one of the three categories:
[olist]
[*][b]Adoration:[/b] How should they adore you? This gives faith to your Disciples
[*][b]Social:[/b] What is acceptable social behavior? These rules will make your people happy
[*][b]Philosophy:[/b] What attitude towards life is righteous? This will make your city more productive (ironically)
[/olist]
Besides their category effect, the Tenets all have their own unique consequences for the culture of your Religion. Picking "Religious Poetry" can trigger a burst of linguistical development, boosting the fame and fortune of your next mission. But it can also boost the Charisma of one of your more poetic Disciples!

These consequences have a nice boosting (or punishing!) effect on your run. The happier your people are, the more likely you will experience the positive consequences of your religion. But let your happiness fall low by overtaxing your followers, and you might experience the downsides of your beliefs, even if that belief is just the beauty of poetry...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/cdfbcb7df13a2a0958723307a7cdbe47499e0c11.gif[/img]

You can expect to play with over 40 unique tenets in the coming update, with 100+ consequences that roll out of them! yes, we went a bit overboard. What can I say, they were fun to make!

[h2]Traditions[/h2]
There is one other big effect of picking a Tenet: A tenet might inspire a Disciple to come with new [b]Tradition[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/64bbf14e422db7c7203baf0308dbeee8507afd41.gif[/img]

If you like their idea, and you have developed your religion far enough. You'll be able to adopt that tradition.
These traditions are rare, and you'll only pick a few of them per run of Godhood. They are of big importance, however! Every tenet gives you a new way to interact with the Disciples and the followers. For example, after picking a violent tenet, you might want pick up the Tradition of Human Sacrifice! 

This will allow you to perform Human Sacrifices, which will greatly boost the tributes you'll gain from Sacraments - provided you have Ancestral and Divine Disciples! Human Sacrifice makes your religion more about the glory of death for the divine. Surely the Smiteswords, Zealots and Rage Prophets would agree!
Look forward to mix and match more than 20 unique Traditions! Which combinations will help you achieve glorious Godhood?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/a2edb54d7f93d0572363a0c0dbb96405f94539b6.gif[/img]

[h2]Thanks for Reading![/h2]
As you can see, we're very excited about our next major update! If you like what you see or have ideas, let us know! The age of Early Access is slowly coming to its end, and we're making ourselves ready for ascension! If you want to see more and smaller sneak peeks or have a chat with us, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/wg2ezX]Discord[/url]!

Hope to see you soon!
- Greetings from the Abbey

notes.title: Moving towards Ascension: Update #6 Sneak-Peek
notes.notes:
Dear religious leaders,
I bring you more good news: Godhood is moving full speed towards its ascension out of Early Access! As promised in our [url=https://community.abbeygames.com/threads/early-access-roadmap-2-0.487/]roadmap[/url], we still had a few things we wanted to see improved. Today I bring you a little peek into our [b]3 major features[/b] for the upcoming update, aimed in improving those points. let's pray for skill and diligence to make it work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/d93bba5c97e0da22206b2702164024f9f2c165c4.gif[/img]
The [b]3 major features[/b] are:
[olist]
[*] [b]Tenet Rework[/b]: Much more mixing and matching of more thematic religious dogmas.
[*] [b]Consequences[/b]: the people of your religion will react to your tenets!
[*] [b]Inspirations & Repeating Rituals[/b]: Disciples will have their own ideas of what to do in the Holy City. Guide their choices!
[/olist] 
They will be accompanied by more changes, small and big.

These will, again, bring massive changes in the way you play the game. Our goal is to make the game more [b]replayable[/b], more [b]religious[/b], more [b]tactical[/b], more [b]strategical[/b], and bring you more [b]surprises[/b]. 

Let's dive into one!
[h2]Consequences[/h2]
From now on, your actions will matter more for your followers. Keep them happy, and they will do things that are in harmony with your religious choices. Disappoint them, and they might lose faith or sin...

For example, what happens if you run a secret society, and someone is having loose lips? Well...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/88fa9a57f83714dc506c71c80145e61988ee611f.gif[/img]

We already have dozens of these small consequences, and are planning on making a lot more! Some bring a minor boost or penalty to your religion, but other consequences might make a deep impact on your little religious society. Who knows what crazy ideas the Disciples might have...?


[h2]Thanks For Reading![/h2]
Like what you see? Have some (crazy) ideas on what consequences could be in the game? Let us know! You can also join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZwKrPws]Discord[/url], where we sometimes spoil a few secrets. Hopefully those angry villagers won't come after us...

With this update we're further improving the quality of Godhood on all fronts, while preparing ourselves for our next big update! The key features are:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/4d348da1b8f33b8d63ceb7190f1f62a72d1e5882.png[/img]

notes.title: Sneak-peek Update #5: Martyrs and Fervor
notes.notes:
Hello aspiring gods!

It's been almost 2 weeks since we launched our biggest update yet with "Newfound Shores"! We're now looking forward to our next update: [b]"Righteous Rituals"[/b]! The update is planned for this month!

This update will [i]again[/i] bring you a set of improvements and features worthy of your religion. Lets take a look at two of the changes we're bringing in:

[h3]Martyrs[/h3]
Think your Disciples can convert any who oppose you? Why not convert more by making your Disciples suffer for the righteous cause! Give the enemy a head-start by jeering and striking your Disciples down, and then impress them with a biblical comeback!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/ae0ed22cb5be3c97327c3270cc9876fac302852b.png[/img]
This way, you can increase the risk you take. The wise will know exactly when they're asking too much of their disciples, and when their devotion will be rewarded.

Our design goals with Martyrs is to reward player's insight, and allow you to take more risks for greater rewards. It also makes the Sacraments a bit quicker.


[h3]Fervor[/h3]
A problem we found was that some player got stuck in a loop of losing and being broken. To address this, we changed carry-over HP into [b]Fervor[/b]. Doing a Mission will cost you Fervor, and being low on Fervor is not good for a Disciple. Fervor automatically regenerates when a Disciple stays home, but old Disciples will have less Fervor!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/e9d78d9b892382a6332a49356cac1a0e4b5c183b.png[/img]
Together with some other smaller changes to the coming of age, we want to give you a more smooth experience. It will make all players think more about their team composition, avoiding new players to be blindsided by high healing costs and aging disciples. It also makes losing physical battles equally jarring for your planning as morale Sacraments.

That wraps this sneak-peek up. We also have more [b]content [/b]and some [b]thematical upgrades[/b] in the pipeline. We can't wait to show them!

 We're happy with the reception for "Newfound Shores", and are looking to bring you more Godhood!
- Greetings from the Monks

notes.title: Update #4: Newfound Shores is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/25847ef83ae2aadf2fdcb9b4094353426a6fb369.png[/img]
[h3][b]Gods and Goddesses, our new update is finally here![/b][/h3]
The "Newfound Shores" Milestone update is ready for you Early Access gods to play with! We're proud and excited to present this big step forward to you!

In short; we made huge improvements to the game and how it plays. Previously, we were not meeting the bar we set ourselves out to achieve. Thanks to you, both supporters and critics, we found ways to make steps forwards. For this update, we focused on the core playability of the game to lay a strong and fun foundation. We're happy with the result you can play now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/e0556800f5574e3084e28eb373b716a930354759.png[/img]

We're not done with Godhood yet, either! This update will be the base for our future work. If you'd like, you can inspect our [url=https://community.abbeygames.com/threads/early-access-roadmap-2-0.487/]Roadmap[/url] and give us some feedback.

Without further ado, here are the release notes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418152/dbb126750c34782cb072cad9544405fa9ef18c50.png[/img]
[u]NEW FEATURES:[/u]
   - [b]Islands[/b]: Go to differently themed island to convert the unenlightened. Each island has different challenges and rewards. Collect the sunstones to become the one Truth!
   - [b]Generosity[/b]: A new commandment for you to spread!
   - [b]Human Sacrifice[/b]: A new tenet to play with!

[u]BIG CHANGES:[/u]
   - [b]Time & Turns[/b]: Pressure is removed from the game to make place for God Actions. You will now have a fixed (upgradeable) number of actions between Missions. Rituals either complete immediately or take a Mission to complete.
   - [b]Dreams[/b]: Appear in the dreams of your Disciples to prepare them for coming challenges!
   - [b]Rituals[/b]: You can now permanently improve your disciples with Rituals. They're not as effective as Miracles though.
   - [b]City Management[/b]: There is now one, central, convenient place to build structures, upgrade them, or unlock classes.
   - [b]Classes[/b]: Every commandment starts with 4 unlocked classes. You can unlock more with Materials.
   - [b]Developments & Followers[/b]: Followers unlock some buildings, and will be important for the end game and your high score. Developments slowly unlock as you complete Missions or when you collect Development Sparks.
   - [b]Crystal Skulls[/b]: You have much more Crystal Skulls, and more chances to upgrade and replenish them. The more crystal skulls you have when you complete a mission, the more rewards you can choose from!
   - [b]Sacrament Conversion[/b]: Instead of depleting an Awe bar, there are now two other ways of victory:
      - converting half or more of the crowd with your glory.
      - breaking all opponents. Violence works best here.
      - When a Disciple is broken, that faction loses 30% of it's converts in the Sacrament.
   - [b]Broken[/b]: A broken character loses a bond. Once a characters loses all 3 bonds, they leave your religion.
   - [b]Ability Styles[/b]: Abilities now have a style of conversion, like Fear or Grace. Disciples have a preferred conversion style, and are more likely to learn these abilities. Some passives already work with it, but it will become more important in the future...
   - [b]Offerings[/b]: You can spend offerings to improve the effect of your actions!

[u]CHANGES:[/u]
   - [b]Tutorial[/b]: Game comes with an improved tutorial.
   - [b]Development Trees[/b]: Development trees are more balanced, and have more options.
   - [b]Big Miracles[/b]: The commandment miracles have special effects.
   - [b]Music[/b]: Some new music has been added.
   - [b]Adoption[/b]: Converting a whole island will give you the chance to adopt one of their tenets.
   - [b]Upgrades[/b]: There are many, many more and better upgrades. e.g. upgrade the amount of XP you get from a Sacrament, or what kind of dreams you can give to your Disciples.
   - [b]Many More[/b]: Many more smaller changes!

[u]FIXES[/u]
   - So much that I don't know where to begin. The Mac/ blocked text bug is still there though, unfortunately. :(

Have criticism or ideas for the game going forward? Please leave them in one of our forums! Enjoying where the game is going? You can help us out with a review or a kind word. :)

We hope you'll enjoy the update, and are looking forward with us to the future of Godhood!

- The Monks from the Abbey

notes.title: Coming Soon: The Will of the People Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Thanks![/h1]
A little over a week has passed, the [b]dust has settled[/b] a bit and it took some time for us to get used to, but the realization has kicked in: [b]Godhood is out in Early Access![/b] Thank you if you purchased an Early Access copy! 

And thanks to those of you who took the time and effort to [b]report bugs[/b], [b]give us feedback[/b] or [b]share your experiences[/b] on the forums![b] We’re trying to respond as much as we can[/b], fix issues [b]as fast we can[/b], and take all your feedback and suggestions[b] into our plans to improve the game[/b] going forward. 

We haven’t missed the [b]mixed reviews[/b] and the well-considered [b]critical feedback[/b] either. Last Thursday we sat down with the entire team to distill the [b]main issues[/b] people have with Godhood.

[h1]These are the most common points of feedback we've heard from you:[/h1]
[list][*] A [b]lack of mechanical depth[/b] in the gameplay experience; there aren’t enough [b]strategic options[/b] and the choices that you make don’t feel meaningful enough - this also discourages multiple playthroughs.
[*] There are [b]no consequences[/b] from failure and no [b]sudden challenges[/b] to overcome.
[*] There is a [b]disconnect[/b] between the [b]fantasy of being a god[/b] and what you[b] actually do[/b] in the game.
[*] The [b]world doesn't feel alive[/b], where you're the only active force.
[*] The Sacraments are [b]unbalanced[/b]; forcing you to focus on quick, high damage, or grind for a long time.
[/list]
[h1]
Coming Soon: The 'Will of the People' update[/h1]
Look forward to us working to expand and improve Godhood with these topics in mind during Early Access. We'll be starting off with the "Will of the People" update. This update will be focused on [b]increasing mechanical depth[/b], adding [b]more challenge[/b] and raising the [b]consequences of your actions[/b].
[list]
[*] It introduces [b]Enthusiasm[/b], which shows how excited your worshippers are about your religion. Go out on the Sacrament while they are excited to [b]get a boost[/b], but wait too long with a Sacrament and the [b]people's enthusiasm will plummet,[/b] causing bad things to happen for your religion!
[*] Tied to this is [b]Tribute[/b]. Resources gathered in your temple site are placed in your [b]tribute[/b], and only by[b] winning a Sacrament[/b] will you earn [b]your (and the enemy's!) tributes[/b]. Lose, and the enemy gets their pick of your tribute...!
[*] We have a couple of [b]other exciting features[/b] planned for this update. [b]Divine intervention in the Sacramen[/b]t, many [b]more building options [/b]to expand your temple site at the cost of [b]materials[/b], a reworking of the [b]Faith[/b] [b]system[/b], and [b]boosting your disciples abilities[/b] for the next Sacrament, to name a few.
[/list]
[b]Expect this first Major Update to hit Early Access on August 7th![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33418152/402383425577bc14707faaf7d2ddc83c94d94786.png[/img]

You can read a more elaborate version of this post, including the announcement of some streaming sessions [url=https://community.abbeygames.com/threads/coming-soon-the-will-of-the-people-update.334/]over on our Community Hub.[/url]
